Review: docs/verification/umvpa-rank-math-review-20261007/README.md. Plan: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-rank-method-plan-v2.md. Receipt SHA256 7756bcb921c05891be81dd173e697d47642cfe2aa9455694e19fdd256581fc78 binds 187 sources and 15 artifacts. Both prior pilot/diagnosis receipts and their source/artifact locks were verified unchanged.

Confirmed a method-level coordinate-dependence defect: the Euclidean canonical-coefficient complement changes H2 counts from 642/720 to 672/720 under an invertible feature shear, despite identical roots and observed Wilks statistic. Independent R and the pinned production kernel reproduce this on JVM and JS; a score-orthogonal completion restores invariance in the example. This is not a proof of type-I inflation and does not quantify the old power deficit. Higher-rank fitted-tail uniform validity remains unresolved. Gaussian residual projection, H1 randomization, and closure have valid conditional arguments. Rootwise interlacing supplies a conservative Gaussian reference for the same unscaled Wilks tail using dimensions (a-s,b), with only the smaller block reduced; derivation and limits are retained.

Full MVPA gates: 465 passed and two opt-in skips on each platform, no compiler warnings. Exhaustive fixed actions only; no new random datasets or confirmation consumed. Initial sbt settings-reload heap failure is retained; ordinary-build retry passed in 95.54 seconds and removed the temporary test source.

Next implementation: upstream score geometry repair and the theorem-backed Gaussian reference, then a separately frozen/resource-probed paired exploratory comparison. Efficiency/bootstrap research is conditional on inadequate reference power. Actual v2 qualification requires new streams, a feasible powered design, independent review and explicit prospective acceptance policy. This proposal does not amend v1 or admit rank. M4.09 stays doing; broader group/family gates remain pending. Releasing this actor's reservations, claim and session.
